'''Lindsey Warner''' is an American voice actress for the English dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She did voice work for the series for three seasons.

==Pokémon roles==
Warner joined {{aniseries|PTS}} around [[S06|season six]], and provided voices for minor characters and Pokémon up to [[S08|season eight]].
